decision: Run isolated storage and real API-toolchain prototypes before sync experiments
why: The user authorized the proposed prototype phase and required no production changes

decision: Separate stable operation IDs from restore generation and conditional versions
why: SQLite restore schedules replayed additive writes while conditional edits retained their version checks

decision: Exercise conditional refresh over real loopback HTTP
why: The first HTTP run exposed inconsistent ETag quoting; correcting the token comparison separated unchanged views from day rollover
result: rerun observed 304 without a body for unchanged views and 200 at rollover for representation validators

decision: Use explicit contributor rows as the working shape
why: Three SQLite representations preserved shared semantics, but aggregate state could not independently address manual contributions; full command history added no required behavior
result: parent rerun completed; exact wide legacy adjustment codec remains necessary

decision: Keep generated contract checks and prefer the exercised Ajv pipeline as a candidate
why: Both pipelines decoded exercised serialized outputs but raw parser, enum, date and numeric semantics disagreed; a deprecated Zod generator lost root constraints
result: parent complete toolchain rerun completed; not schema-equivalent or RN-proven
